Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.spawn

Class PlayerFactory

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.spawn.PlayerFactory
public final class PlayerFactory extends Object
Builds the players of data/characters.json for the CharacterFactory (Q23, Q129). On top of the values every character shares, it reads the "weapon" and the "armor" they start with, built by the ItemFactory.

Pattern: Simple Factory.

      public PlayerFactory(ItemFactory items, PlayerInput input, World world)
      Creates a factory for the players of the given world.
      Parameters:
      items - builds the weapon each player starts with
      input - what the user asks for; every player it builds reads it

  • Method Details

    • create

      public Player create(PlayerKind kind, CharacterSpec spec, com.badlogic.gdx.utils.JsonValue entry, Aabb body)
      Builds a player holding the weapon of its entry. The caller adds it to the world.
      Parameters:
      kind - the class to build
      spec - the values every character shares, read from its entry
      entry - its whole entry, for its "weapon" and its "armor"
      body - its body box, already placed in the world; also its hurtbox
      Returns:
      a new player of the given kind
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the weapon or the armor is missing, unknown or not of its type
